full_list.title_en: Accelerating high-throughput catalyst screening by direct generation of equilibrium adsorption structures

full_list.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 21 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79243-9 The authors develop DBCata, a generative model trained without energy or force labels to produce near-equilibrium adsorption structures, enabling faster screening of candidate catalysts.
full_list.abstract_zh: 作者开发了 DBCata，这是一种在没有能量或力标签的情况下训练的生成模型，可产生接近平衡的吸附结构，从而能够更快地筛选候选催化剂。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 作者开发了 DBCata，这是一种在没有能量或力标签的情况下训练的生成模型，可产生接近平衡的吸附结构，从而能够更快地筛选候选催化剂。
full_list.summary: 作者开发了 DBCata，这是一种在没有能量或力标签的情况下训练的生成模型，可产生接近平衡的吸附结构，从而能够更快地筛选候选催化剂。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“用 ML 代理能量和不确定性缩小结构搜索，再对候选做对称性、动力学稳定性、极化/磁序和有限温度筛选，避免只按 0 K 单点能排序”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到新型铁电、磁性、钙钛矿、二维和能源材料候选。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在新型铁电、磁性、钙钛矿、二维和能源材料候选中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“用 ML 代理能量和不确定性缩小结构搜索，再对候选做对称性、动力学稳定性、极化/磁序和有限温度筛选，避免只按 0 K 单点能排序”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过直接生成平衡吸附结构加速高通量催化剂筛选》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Simulation-Guided Optimization of Cigs Heterojunction Solar Cells for Through-Fire Imaging as Calibrated Photodetectors
full_list.title_zh: 模拟引导优化 Cigs 异质结太阳能电池作为校准光电探测器进行直射成像
full_list.abstract: This study assesses the feasibility of copper indium gallium selenide (CIGS) heterojunction photodetectors for imaging through fire under optical absorption, turbulence-induced blur, and sensor noise. SCAPS-1D device simulations varied the absorber doping concentration, interface trap density, and recombination parameters to obtain the current density–voltage (J–V) characteristics and quantum efficiency, from which the spectral responsivity, noise-equivalent power (NEP), and specific detectivity (D*) were calculated. An image formation model incorporating these degradations was developed to evaluate imaging performance. Contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE) and wavelet-based filtering were compared using peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), and contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and fire/no-fire classification was performed with histogram of oriented gradients (HOG) features and a linear support vector machine (SVM). Increasing the acceptor concentration raised the simulated efficiency from 16.66% to 21.75%. At 808 nm, the photodetector achieved a responsivity of 0.652 A/W and an NEP of 2.16 × 10⁻¹⁴ W·Hz− 1/2. Wavelet-based enhancement increased the mean SSIM from 0.321 to 0.733, and the classifier achieved approximately 82% accuracy and 90% fire-class recall. These simulation results indicate the potential of combining CIGS photodetector design with image restoration and machine learning for through-fire imaging.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了铜铟镓硒 (CIGS) 异质结光电探测器在光吸收、湍流引起的模糊和传感器噪声下透过火焰成像的可行性。 SCAPS-1D 器件模拟改变了吸收体掺杂浓度、界面陷阱密度和复合参数，以获得电流密度-电压 (J-V) 特性和量子效率，由此计算光谱响应度、噪声等效功率 (NEP) 和比探测率 (D*)。开发了包含这些退化的图像形成模型来评估成像性能。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本研究评估了铜铟镓硒 (CIGS) 异质结光电探测器在光吸收、湍流引起的模糊和传感器噪声下透过火焰成像的可行性。 SCAPS-1D 器件模拟改变了吸收体掺杂浓度、界面陷阱密度和复合参数，以获得电流密度-电压 (J-V) 特性和量子效率，由此计算光谱响应度、噪声等效功率 (NEP) 和比探测率 (D*)。开发了包含这些退化的图像形成模型来评估成像性能。使用峰值信噪比 (PSNR)、结构相似指数 (SSIM) 和对比度噪声比 (CNR) 比较限制对比度自适应直方图均衡 (CLAHE) 和基于小波的滤波，并使用定向梯度直方图 (HOG) 特征和线性支持向量机 (SVM) 进行火灾/非火灾分类。增加受体浓度将模拟效率从 16.66% 提高到 21.75%。在808 nm处，光电探测器的响应率为0.652 A/W，NEP为2.16 × 10⁻14 W·Hz− 1/2。基于小波的增强将平均 SSIM 从 0.321 增加到 0.733，并且分类器实现了大约 82% 的准确度和 90% 的火灾级召回率。这些仿真结果表明将 CIGS 光电探测器设计与图像恢复和机器学习相结合进行直射成像的潜力。

full_list.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 21 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79625-z Strong polarization–strain coupling limits the energy density and reliability of lead-free dielectric capacitors. Here, the authors show that entropy-engineered polar heterogeneity weakens this coupling, enabling ultrahigh energy storage with minimal electrostrain.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《熵工程设计的极性异质性可实现高密度储能的近解耦极化应变行为》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Annealing-Induced Nanosheet Formation in Sputtered VOx for High-Performance NH3 Sensing
full_list.title_zh: 溅射 VOx 中退火诱导的纳米片形成，用于高性能 NH3 传感
full_list.abstract: This study presents the fabrication and optimization of VOx thin-film Ammonia (NH3) gas sensors deposited by reactive DC magnetron sputtering, followed by systematic post-annealing in the temperature range of 100–550°C. Systematic correlations between annealing temperature, phase composition, film morphology, and NH3 sensing response were established. X-ray diffraction analysis revealed a transition from an amorphous structure to a highly crystalline, preferentially oriented orthorhombic V2O5 phase, with the nearly phase-pure, highly crystalline structure obtained at annealing temperatures of 480°C and above. FESEM observations demonstrated significant morphological evolution, culminating in the formation of porous nanosheet-like structures at 480°C. Such a morphology is expected to expose more accessible surface sites and facilitate NH3 diffusion, thereby contributing to the enhanced sensing performance. Gas sensing measurements toward NH3 showed a strong dependence on annealing temperature, with each sensor exhibiting a distinct optimum operating temperature governed by adsorption–desorption and surface reaction kinetics. Among all samples, the 480°C annealed sensor exhibited the best performance, achieving a maximum sensitivity of 104% toward 50 ppm NH3 at an operating temperature of 207°C, along with fast response–recovery behavior and excellent stability. The enhanced sensing performance is attributed primarily to the optimized crystallinity, reduced lattice microstrain, and porous nanosheet morphology achieved at the 480°C annealing condition. Literature-reported V5+/V4+ mediated surface redox processes in V2O5 may also contribute to the observed NH3 response. The 460°C annealed sensor additionally achieves sensitivities of 42% at 67°C, indicating viable low-power operating conditions. Overall, this work demonstrates that controlled post-annealing is a key strategy for tuning VOx thin-film properties and provides a simple, scalable, and cost-effective approach for the development of high-performance NH3 gas sensors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究介绍了通过反应直流磁控溅射沉积的 VOx 薄膜氨 (NH3) 气体传感器的制造和优化，然后在 100–550°C 的温度范围内进行系统的后退火。建立了退火温度、相组成、薄膜形态和 NH3 传感响应之间的系统相关性。 X 射线衍射分析揭示了从非晶结构到高度结晶、优先取向的斜方 V2O5 相的转变，在 480°C 及以上的退火温度下获得了接近纯相的高度结晶结构。 FESEM 观察结果表明，形态发生了显着的演变，最终在 480°C 下形成了多孔纳米片状结构。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本研究介绍了通过反应直流磁控溅射沉积的 VOx 薄膜氨 (NH3) 气体传感器的制造和优化，然后在 100–550°C 的温度范围内进行系统的后退火。建立了退火温度、相组成、薄膜形态和 NH3 传感响应之间的系统相关性。 X 射线衍射分析揭示了从非晶结构到高度结晶、优先取向的斜方 V2O5 相的转变，在 480°C 及以上的退火温度下获得了接近纯相的高度结晶结构。 FESEM 观察结果表明，形态发生了显着的演变，最终在 480°C 下形成了多孔纳米片状结构。这种形态有望暴露更多可接近的表面位点并促进 NH3 扩散，从而有助于增强传感性能。对 NH3 的气体传感测量显示出对退火温度的强烈依赖性，每个传感器都表现出由吸附-解吸和表面反应动力学控制的独特的最佳工作温度。在所有样品中，480°C 退火传感器表现出最佳性能，在 207°C 的工作温度下对 50 ppm NH3 实现了 104% 的最大灵敏度，同时具有快速响应恢复行为和出色的稳定性。传感性能的增强主要归因于在 480°C 退火条件下实现的优化结晶度、降低的晶格微应变和多孔纳米片形态。文献报道的 V5+/V4+ 介导的 V2O5 表面氧化还原过程也可能有助于观察到的 NH3 响应。 460°C 退火传感器在 67°C 时还实现了 42% 的灵敏度，表明可行的低功耗工作条件。总体而言，这项工作表明，受控后退火是调节 VOx 薄膜特性的关键策略，并为高性能 NH3 气体传感器的开发提供了一种简单、可扩展且经济高效的方法。
full_list.summary: 本研究介绍了通过反应直流磁控溅射沉积的 VOx 薄膜氨 (NH3) 气体传感器的制造和优化，然后在 100–550°C 的温度范围内进行系统的后退火。建立了退火温度、相组成、薄膜形态和 NH3 传感响应之间的系统相关性。 X 射线衍射分析揭示了从非晶结构到高度结晶、优先取向的斜方 V2O5 相的转变，在 480°C 及以上的退火温度下获得了接近纯相的高度结晶结构。 FESEM 观察结果表明，形态发生了显着的演变，最终在 480°C 下形成了多孔纳米片状结构。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《溅射 VOx 中退火诱导的纳米片形成，用于高性能 NH3 传感》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Composite solid surface parabolic reflector of spacecraft mirror antenna: design and testing
full_list.title_zh: 航天器镜面天线复合固体表面抛物面反射器：设计与测试
full_list.abstract: This paper presents a novel design for a composite ultralightweight solid surface reflector intended for spacecraft mirror antennas. The reflector comprises reflecting and supporting shells, both sharing a parabolic shape and joined at the aperture edges. This configuration forms a closed structure that provides substantial rigidity. Through parametric finite element modal analysis, a physical prototype of the parabolic reflector with an aperture diameter of 0.6 m and a focal distance of 0.15 m was designed, manufactured, and tested. A fabrication technology was developed to ensure minimal deviations of the reflective shell geometry from the ideal paraboloid. The reflector underwent vibration and thermal testing, which confirmed that the composite design can withstand the mechanical and thermal loads experienced during spacecraft injection into Earth’s orbit and subsequent orbiting. The resulting composite parabolic reflector is ultralightweight and meets all necessary requirements for generating narrowly directed electromagnetic radiation at high frequencies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于航天器镜面天线的复合超轻固体表面反射器的新颖设计。反射器包括反射壳和支撑壳，两者共享抛物线形状并在孔边缘处接合。这种构造形成了提供很大刚性的封闭结构。通过参数化有限元模态分析，设计、制作并测试了孔径直径为0.6 m、焦距为0.15 m的抛物面反射镜物理样机。开发了一种制造技术，以确保反射壳几何形状与理想抛物面的偏差最小。反射器经过了振动和热测试，证实复合材料设计能够承受航天器注入地球轨道和随后绕轨道运行期间所经历的机械和热载荷。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种用于航天器镜面天线的复合超轻固体表面反射器的新颖设计。反射器包括反射壳和支撑壳，两者共享抛物线形状并在孔边缘处接合。这种构造形成了提供很大刚性的封闭结构。通过参数化有限元模态分析，设计、制作并测试了孔径直径为0.6 m、焦距为0.15 m的抛物面反射镜物理样机。开发了一种制造技术，以确保反射壳几何形状与理想抛物面的偏差最小。反射器经过了振动和热测试，证实复合材料设计能够承受航天器注入地球轨道和随后绕轨道运行期间所经历的机械和热载荷。由此产生的复合抛物面反射器重量超轻，并且满足在高频下产生窄定向电磁辐射的所有必要要求。

full_list.title_en: Efficient Degradation of Rhodamine B by g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl Composite Photocatalyst Adsorption under Visible-Light Irradiation
full_list.title_zh: 可见光照射下g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合光催化剂吸附高效降解罗丹明B
full_list.abstract: In this study, CaCO3/BiOCl was first synthesized via a solvothermal method, and subsequently combined with g-C3N4 under magnetic stirring to fabricate g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl composite materials. The phase structure, morphology, functional groups, and optical absorption properties of the samples were characterized by XRD, SEM, FT-IR, and UV-Vis DRS, respectively. Under irradiation from a 300 W Xe lamp, with RhB as the model pollutant. The photocatalytic degradation efficiency of RhB over the g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl composite reached 98.81% within 60min, which is approximately 2.49 times and 1.38 times that of pure BiOCl and CaCO3/BiOCl, respectively. After five consecutive cycling tests, the degradation efficiency still remained above 95%, demonstrating excellent photocatalytic stability. UV-Vis diffuse reflectance spectra (DRS) and Tauc Polt revealed that the composite photocatalyst possesses a narrow bandgap of 2.5 eV, indicative of enhanced visible-light absorption. Meanwhile, PL, TPC, and EIS confirmed the efficient separation of photogenerated electron-hole pairs. The combined effects of broadened light absorption and suppressed charge recombination, contributed to the significantly enhanced photocatalytic performance. Results suggest that the g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl composite material exhibits promising potential for application in photocatalytic degradation of wastewater pollutants.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究首先通过溶剂热法合成了CaCO3/BiOCl，然后在磁力搅拌下与g-C3N4结合制备了g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合材料。分别通过 XRD、SEM、FT-IR 和 UV-Vis DRS 对样品的相结构、形貌、官能团和光吸收性能进行了表征。在 300 W 氙灯照射下，以 RhB 作为模型污染物。 RhB对g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合材料的光催化降解效率在60分钟内达到98.81%，分别约为纯BiOCl和CaCO3/BiOCl的2.49倍和1.38倍。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本研究首先通过溶剂热法合成了CaCO3/BiOCl，然后在磁力搅拌下与g-C3N4结合制备了g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合材料。分别通过 XRD、SEM、FT-IR 和 UV-Vis DRS 对样品的相结构、形貌、官能团和光吸收性能进行了表征。在 300 W 氙灯照射下，以 RhB 作为模型污染物。 RhB对g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合材料的光催化降解效率在60分钟内达到98.81%，分别约为纯BiOCl和CaCO3/BiOCl的2.49倍和1.38倍。经过连续5次循环测试，降解效率仍保持在95%以上，表现出优异的光催化稳定性。紫外-可见漫反射光谱 (DRS) 和 Tauc Polt 表明，复合光催化剂具有 2.5 eV 的窄带隙，表明可见光吸收增强。同时，PL、TPC和EIS证实了光生电子-空穴对的有效分离。拓宽的光吸收和抑制电荷复合的综合效应有助于显着增强光催化性能。结果表明，g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合材料在光催化降解废水污染物方面表现出良好的应用潜力。
full_list.summary: 本研究首先通过溶剂热法合成了CaCO3/BiOCl，然后在磁力搅拌下与g-C3N4结合制备了g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合材料。分别通过 XRD、SEM、FT-IR 和 UV-Vis DRS 对样品的相结构、形貌、官能团和光吸收性能进行了表征。在 300 W 氙灯照射下，以 RhB 作为模型污染物。 RhB对g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合材料的光催化降解效率在60分钟内达到98.81%，分别约为纯BiOCl和CaCO3/BiOCl的2.49倍和1.38倍。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《可见光照射下g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合光催化剂吸附高效降解罗丹明B》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic-Field-Assisted Hydrothermal Synthesis of Rod-Like Fe 3 O 4 : Morphology Evolution and Magnetic Retention under Flow
full_list.title_zh: 磁场辅助水热合成棒状 Fe 3 O 4 ：流动下的形貌演化和磁保留
full_list.abstract: An external magnetic field can influence the anisotropic growth of magnetic nanocrystals; however, the relationship between field-induced morphology and magnetic retention under flow remains insufficiently understood. In this study, Fe3O4 was synthesized hydrothermally under a magnetic field of 0.36 T (F-Fe3O4) and under otherwise identical zero-field conditions (Z-Fe3O4). The effects of NaOH dosage, reaction time, and temperature on product formation were investigated, and the resulting samples were characterized in terms of crystal structure, morphology, and magnetic properties. Both samples retained the magnetite crystal structure. F-Fe3O4 exhibited a rod-like morphology, with a length of approximately 75 nm and a width of approximately 25 nm. HRTEM analysis indicated that F-Fe3O4 grew along the easy magnetization axis [110]. In contrast, Z-Fe3O4 consisted of irregular polygonal and spherical particles with diameters of 12–18 nm. Increasing the NaOH dosage promoted particle elongation, whereas shorter reaction times and higher temperatures suppressed rod formation. F-Fe3O4 exhibited a discontinuity near 270 K, attributed to the Verwey transition, and a saturation magnetization of 54.2 emu g-1,compared with 106.3 emu g-1 for Z-Fe3O4. After silica coating, the saturation magnetization of F-Fe3O4@SiO2 was 20.39 emu g-1. In a flowing-water model under an external magnetic field, the retention rates of F-Fe3O4, Z-Fe3O4, and F-Fe3O4@SiO2 were 68.43%, 66.09%, and 52.18%, respectively. These results establish a relationship between magnetic-field-assisted morphology evolution, magnetic properties, and magnetic retention under flow.
full_list.abstract_zh: 外部磁场可以影响磁性纳米晶体的各向异性生长；然而，场诱导形态与流动下磁保留之间的关系仍不清楚。在这项研究中，Fe3O4 是在 0.36 T 磁场（F-Fe3O4）和其他相同的零场条件（Z-Fe3O4）下水热合成的。研究了 NaOH 用量、反应时间和温度对产物形成的影响，并对所得样品的晶体结构、形貌和磁性能进行了表征。两个样品都保留了磁铁矿晶体结构。 F-Fe3O4呈棒状形貌，长度约为75 nm，宽度约为25 nm。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 外部磁场可以影响磁性纳米晶体的各向异性生长；然而，场诱导形态与流动下磁保留之间的关系仍不清楚。在这项研究中，Fe3O4 是在 0.36 T 磁场（F-Fe3O4）和其他相同的零场条件（Z-Fe3O4）下水热合成的。研究了 NaOH 用量、反应时间和温度对产物形成的影响，并对所得样品的晶体结构、形貌和磁性能进行了表征。两个样品都保留了磁铁矿晶体结构。 F-Fe3O4呈棒状形貌，长度约为75 nm，宽度约为25 nm。 HRTEM 分析表明 F-Fe3O4 沿易磁化轴生长[110]。相比之下，Z-Fe3O4 由不规则的多边形和球形颗粒组成，直径为 12-18 nm。增加 NaOH 剂量可促进颗粒伸长，而较短的反应时间和较高的温度则抑制棒的形成。 F-Fe3O4 在 270 K 附近表现出由 Verwey 转变引起的不连续性，饱和磁化强度为 54.2 emu g-1，而 Z-Fe3O4 的饱和磁化强度为 106.3 emu g-1。二氧化硅包覆后，F-Fe3O4@SiO2的饱和磁化强度为20.39 emu g-1。在外磁场流水模型中，F-Fe3O4、Z-Fe3O4和F-Fe3O4@SiO2的保留率分别为68.43%、66.09%和52.18%。这些结果建立了磁场辅助形态演化、磁性和流动下磁保留之间的关系。

full_list.title_en: QBM: A Quantum Bayesian Machine for Relaxed Energy Prediction on Metal-Oxide Electrocatalysts
full_list.title_zh: QBM：用于金属氧化物电催化剂宽松能量预测的量子贝叶斯机
full_list.abstract: Predicting the relaxed total energy of an oxide catalyst from its initial structure can reduce the number of density-functional-theory relaxations needed for screening. We use the Open Catalyst 2022 benchmark to examine three roles for simulated quantum circuits in a fixed-descriptor surrogate: proposing feature subsets, defining a fidelity kernel and learning a residual correction. In the reported 16-component comparison, the quantum approximate optimisation algorithm proposed a pool that required 333 subset fits, compared with 65,535 for enumeration. Validation error rose in domain and fell out of domain in the matched fit. Across six seed-paired fits, a validation-selected fidelity kernel reduced in-domain mean absolute error by a median of 4.33 meV per atom relative to linear ridge regression, with no median improvement out of domain. A trainable re-uploading circuit reduced in-domain error relative to ridge by a median of 1.28 meV per atom across five paired fits, with overlapping seed ranges. Under ideal CPU simulation, the clearest effect was subset pruning.
full_list.abstract_zh: 从氧化物催化剂的初始结构预测其弛豫总能量可以减少筛选所需的密度泛函理论弛豫次数。我们使用 Open Catalyst 2022 基准测试来检查固定描述符代理中模拟量子电路的三个角色：提出特征子集、定义保真度内核和学习残差校正。在报告的 16 个分量比较中，量子近似优化算法提出了一个需要 333 个子集拟合的池，而枚举需要 65,535 个子集拟合。验证错误在匹配的拟合中在域内上升并在域外下降。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 从氧化物催化剂的初始结构预测其弛豫总能量可以减少筛选所需的密度泛函理论弛豫次数。我们使用 Open Catalyst 2022 基准测试来检查固定描述符代理中模拟量子电路的三个角色：提出特征子集、定义保真度内核和学习残差校正。在报告的 16 个分量比较中，量子近似优化算法提出了一个需要 333 个子集拟合的池，而枚举需要 65,535 个子集拟合。验证错误在匹配的拟合中在域内上升并在域外下降。在六种种子配对拟合中，相对于线性岭回归，验证选择的保真度内核将域内平均绝对误差降低了每原子 4.33 meV 的中值，而域外中值没有改善。可训练的重新上传电路将五对拟合中相对于脊的域内误差减少了每原子 1.28 meV 的中位数，并且种子范围重叠。在理想的CPU模拟下，最明显的效果是子集剪枝。
full_list.summary: 从氧化物催化剂的初始结构预测其弛豫总能量可以减少筛选所需的密度泛函理论弛豫次数。我们使用 Open Catalyst 2022 基准测试来检查固定描述符代理中模拟量子电路的三个角色：提出特征子集、定义保真度内核和学习残差校正。在报告的 16 个分量比较中，量子近似优化算法提出了一个需要 333 个子集拟合的池，而枚举需要 65,535 个子集拟合。验证错误在匹配的拟合中在域内上升并在域外下降。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《QBM：用于金属氧化物电催化剂宽松能量预测的量子贝叶斯机》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: When Quantum Characterization Is Sufficient for a Decision
full_list.title_zh: 当量子表征足以做出决策时
full_list.abstract: Quantum characterization serves as the information interface between quantum hardware and the software that calibrates, compiles, verifies, and mitigates it. Yet a record can be arbitrarily precise and still omit the coordinate that controls a downstream decision. We formulate decision completeness: a characterization map C determines a local decision map A exactly when ker C is contained in ker A. This criterion is reconstruction-free and identifies the minimal task-directed augmentation within the declared local model. For a qubit braid rewrite, average fidelity and unitarity are constant on their data-compatible fiber while the preferred circuit reverses; these records therefore carry exactly zero mutual information about the decision for every prior supported on that fiber. A finite-error rule certifies left, certifies right, or abstains. On two public time-resolved gate-set-tomography acquisitions, the model is fitted separately to the first temporal half of each acquisition, while a selection threshold chosen on the first acquisition is transferred unchanged to the second. The resulting selector reaches 93.7% accuracy on 79 decidable pairs, versus 72.2% for the same-subset majority. On 151 fixed pairs, increasing characterization depth raises accuracy from 29.1% to 90.1%. Negative cross-date, cross-model, and software tests delimit transportability. In a separate audit of 14 public hardware-trained open-evolution models, 654 of 773 correlated rewrite targets reverse within the lower-fit-error half, excluding a condition-independent lookup rule in that modeled family. Expanding a generic probe from 7 to 15 settings reaches full training rank but does not improve held-out ranking. Characterization is thus complete only relative to the decisions it must support.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子表征充当量子硬件与校准、编译、验证和缓解量子硬件的软件之间的信息接口。然而，记录可以是任意精确的，并且仍然忽略控制下游决策的坐标。我们制定决策完整性：当 ker C 包含在 ker A 中时，特征图 C 准确地确定局部决策图 A。该标准是免重构的，并识别声明的局部模型内的最小任务导向增强。对于量子位编织重写，其数据兼容光纤上的平均保真度和单一性是恒定的，而首选电路则相反；因此，这些记录携带的有关该光纤上每个先前支持的决策的相互信息恰好为零。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《当量子表征足以做出决策时》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: An Analytical Feasibility Boundary Reveals A Near-Threshold Identifiability Limit for Externally Transmitted Confinement in Closed Mitosis
full_list.title_zh: 分析可行性边界揭示了封闭有丝分裂中外部传播限制的近阈值可识别性限制
full_list.abstract: Closed mitosis mechanically couples an elongated spindle to a deformable nuclear envelope (NE), but it is unclear when mechanical confinement outside the cell could become relevant to this intranuclear force balance. I formulate a deliberately reduced problem: an externally imposed confinement pressure (pcₒₙfᵢₙₑ) is transmitted to the NE with an unknown fraction (T), producing an effective load (pₑff  =  T pcₒₙfᵢₙₑ). Combining established membrane-tether mechanics with an adopted spindle-force threshold (Fb), I derive an exact dimensionless feasibility boundary. With (f₀  =  2πsqrt2κσ), (μ  =  fracFbf₀), and (χ  =  Tpcₒₙfᵢₙₑsqrtfracκ2σ³), threshold compatibility for (μ ≥ 1) is (χ ≥ q*(μ)), where (q*(μ)) is available in closed form. The boundary is strictly increasing and convex. Its exact logarithmic sensitivities diverge as (μ → 1⁺), making numerical thresholds intrinsically ill-conditioned near the μ=1 boundary. Using Lim et al.'s fitted membrane ratio with their adopted effective bending rigidity ((κ  =  400pN nm, σ  =  0.026fracpNnm)) together with an illustrative (Fb  =  31pN) gives (μ approx 1.082) and (p* approx 113 Pa). However, the local elasticity with respect to (Fb) is approximately 15.1. Thus, the numerical pressure is not a robust biological prediction. Instead, the analysis identifies a near-boundary calibration and identifiability limitation. Scenario propagation shows frequent switching into the μ≤ 1 regime under modest parameter perturbations, especially when the fitted membrane ratio is preserved. Spindle-force calibration and external-to-NE load transmission must be measured before confinement can be assigned a quantitative role in closed mitosis.
full_list.abstract_zh: 闭合有丝分裂将细长的纺锤体与可变形的核膜（NE）机械耦合，但尚不清楚细胞外的机械限制何时与这种核内力平衡相关。我精心设计了一个简化的问题：外部施加的约束压力 (pcₒₙfᵢₙₑ) 以未知分数 (T) 传输到 NE，产生有效载荷 (pₑff = T pcₒₙfᵢₙₑ)。将已建立的膜系链力学与采用的主轴力阈值 (Fb) 相结合，我得出了精确的无量纲可行性边界。

full_list.title_en: Engineering High-Performance ZnO/P3HT Hybrid Heterostructure Diodes: Systematic Layer-Dependent Optimization of Structural, Morphological, and Optical Properties
full_list.title_zh: 工程高性能 ZnO/P3HT 混合异质结构二极管：结构、形态和光学特性的系统层相关优化
full_list.abstract: Hybrid organic-inorganic solar cells combining zinc oxide (ZnO) and poly(3-hexylthiophene) (P3HT) represent a promising avenue for cost-effective photovoltaic technology. This study systematically investigates the fabrication and optimization of ZnO/P3HT heterostructure diodes prepared via sol-gel spin-coating on borosilicate glass substrates. We examine the effects of layer number (4, 6, 8, and 10 layers for ZnO; 2, 3, 4, and 5 layers for P3HT) and calcination temperature on structural, morphological, and optical properties. X-ray diffraction analysis reveals that 8-layer ZnO films yield optimal crystallite size (36.11 nm), minimum internal strain (3.4×10⁻³), and superior hexagonal wurtzite phase formation. For P3HT, 4-layer configuration achieves maximum lamellar ordering with optimal (100) peak intensity (1386.30 cts) and d-spacing of 18.63 Å. Scanning electron microscopy confirms homogeneous, continuous film morphology for optimized configurations. UV-Vis spectroscopy demonstrates excellent optical transparency (> 98% at 800 nm) and optimal bandgap (3.335 eV) for 8-layer ZnO. A thermally-separated fabrication protocol addresses the thermal incompatibility between ZnO calcination (450°C) and P3HT processing (< 195°C degradation threshold). The optimized ZnO (8 layers) /P3HT (4 layers) architecture establishes fundamental design principles for high-performance hybrid photovoltaic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 结合氧化锌（ZnO）和聚（3-己基噻吩）（P3HT）的混合有机-无机太阳能电池代表了一种具有成本效益的光伏技术的有前途的途径。本研究系统地研究了通过溶胶-凝胶旋涂在硼硅酸盐玻璃基板上制备的 ZnO/P3HT 异质结构二极管的制造和优化。我们研究了层数（ZnO 为 4、6、8 和 10 层；P3HT 为 2、3、4 和 5 层）和煅烧温度对结构、形态和光学性能的影响。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 结合氧化锌（ZnO）和聚（3-己基噻吩）（P3HT）的混合有机-无机太阳能电池代表了一种具有成本效益的光伏技术的有前途的途径。本研究系统地研究了通过溶胶-凝胶旋涂在硼硅酸盐玻璃基板上制备的 ZnO/P3HT 异质结构二极管的制造和优化。我们研究了层数（ZnO 为 4、6、8 和 10 层；P3HT 为 2、3、4 和 5 层）和煅烧温度对结构、形态和光学性能的影响。 X射线衍射分析表明，8层ZnO薄膜具有最佳的微晶尺寸（36.11 nm）、最小的内应变（3.4×10³）和优异的六方纤锌矿相形成。对于 P3HT，4 层配置实现了最大层状有序性，具有最佳 (100) 峰强度 (1386.30 cts) 和 18.63 Å 的 d 间距。扫描电子显微镜证实了优化配置的均匀、连续的薄膜形态。紫外-可见光谱显示 8 层 ZnO 具有出色的光学透明度（800 nm 处>98%）和最佳带隙（3.335 eV）。热分离制造协议解决了 ZnO 煅烧 (450°C) 和 P3HT 处理（< 195°C 降解阈值）之间的热不相容性。优化的 ZnO（8 层）/P3HT（4 层）架构为高性能混合光伏器件建立了基本设计原则。

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《工程高性能 ZnO/P3HT 混合异质结构二极管：结构、形态和光学特性的系统层相关优化》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Excitons mimic light in atom-thin material, confirming decade-old quantum prediction
full_list.title_zh: 激子在原子薄材料中模拟光，证实了十年前的量子预测
full_list.abstract: Combining their skills in theory and experiment, Yale researchers have observed for the first time a type of energy-carrying composite particle move in a highly unexpected way. It's a finding that could lead to advances in quantum technologies, solar energy, LEDs and other optoelectronic technologies. The work is published in Nature Physics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 耶鲁大学的研究人员结合理论和实验技能，首次观察到一种携带能量的复合粒子以一种非常意想不到的方式移动。这一发现可能会推动量子技术、太阳能、LED 和其他光电技术的进步。该工作发表在《自然物理学》上。

full_list.title_en: Modeling Ingestion and Clearance Kinetics of Polydispersed Micro- and Nanoplastics in Daphnia magna Utilizing spICP-MS
full_list.title_zh: 利用 spICP-MS 模拟大型溞中多分散微塑料和纳米塑料的摄入和清除动力学
full_list.abstract: Current models of nano- and microplastic (NMP) ingestion and clearance often lack environmental relevance because they rely on spherical, monodispersions rather than the irregularly shaped, polydispersed fragments commonly found in nature. To address this, we employed a recently published method where we metal-doped tantalum ethoxide poly(methyl methacrylate) (Ta-PMMA) polydispersion (~ 280–3350 nm) which allowed analysis of NMPs in media and organisms using single-particle inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (spICP-MS). The ingestion and clearance of Ta-PMMA NMPs were quantified in Daphnia magna following exposure to 50 µg/L Ta-PMMA (individual and group exposures) or 1.5 µg/L 200 nm AgNPs (monodispersion control) for 24 h, followed by 24 h clearance in clean media. D. magna were sampled four times between 3–24 h (exposure) and three times between 24–48 h (depuration). Ingestion of Ta-PMMA and AgNPs peaked at 6 and 12 h, respectively, suggesting ingestion followed by a cessation of feeding before exposures ended. Particle distributions measured in exposure media and exposed D. magna were consistent for individually exposed D. magna but differed in group exposures, where greater ingestion occurred for particles < 1 µm. Exposure set-up affected particle distribution in media, complicating direct comparisons between individual and group exposures. This research highlight the importance of incorporating environmentally relevant polydispersed NMPs into ingestion–clearance studies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 目前的纳米和微塑料 (NMP) 摄入和清除模型通常缺乏环境相关性，因为它们依赖于球形、单分散性，而不是自然界中常见的不规则形状、多分散碎片。为了解决这个问题，我们采用了最近发布的一种方法，其中我们使用金属掺杂的乙醇钽聚（甲基丙烯酸甲酯）（Ta-PMMA）多分散体（~ 280–3350 nm），该方法允许使用单颗粒电感耦合等离子体质谱（spICP-MS）分析介质和生物体中的NMP。

full_list.title_en: When chlorophyll tells a different story: Comparing ecotoxicological endpoints in Baltic microphytobenthos
full_list.title_zh: 当叶绿素讲述不同的故事时：比较波罗的海微型底栖植物的生态毒理学终点
full_list.abstract: Chlorophyll a concentration is widely used to assess microalgal responses to chemical exposure, but may diverge from structural and photophysiological measurements. We reanalysed chlorophyll a, community biovolume and maximum photosystem II quantum efficiency (Fv/Fm) measured in the same biological replicates of natural Baltic microphytobenthic assemblages exposed to 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium chloride ([BMIM]Cl) or the glyphosate-based formulation Roundup®. Responses were compared with same-day controls after 1, 3 and 7 days. On day 7, mean chlorophyll a concentrations under [BMIM]Cl exposure were approximately 113% higher than controls, whereas biovolume and Fv/Fm were 23.5–50.9% and 45.0–47.6% lower, respectively. Under Roundup® exposure, lower biovolume coincided with elevated or near-control chlorophyll a; Fv/Fm remained near the control at the lower concentration but was lower at the higher concentration. At the higher Roundup® concentration, all three endpoints were below controls initially, but chlorophyll a approached the control by day 7. These descriptive patterns show that endpoint agreement depends on exposure conditions and sampling time. Combined measurements distinguish changes in pigment content, biovolume and PSII efficiency that chlorophyll a alone does not capture.
full_list.abstract_zh: 叶绿素 a 浓度广泛用于评估微藻对化学暴露的反应，但可能与结构和光生理学测量有所不同。我们重新分析了暴露于氯化 1-丁基-3-甲基咪唑鎓 ([BMIM]Cl) 或基于草甘膦的配方 Roundup® 的天然波罗的海微型底栖植物组合的相同生物复制品中测量的叶绿素 a、群落生物体积和最大光系统 II 量子效率 (Fv/Fm)。 1、3 和 7 天后将反应与当天的对照进行比较。

full_list.title_en: Adsorption of Digoxin by Activated carbon prepared from Walnut shell
full_list.title_zh: 核桃壳活性炭吸附地高辛
full_list.abstract: To explore a low-cost candidate adsorbent for digoxin decontamination, this study evaluated the adsorption of digoxin from a simulated physiological buffer (PBS, pH 7.4) using activated carbon (AC) derived from walnut-shell biomass via food-grade phosphoric acid (H3PO4) activation. Optimization of preparation conditions yielded a material with a maximum iodine number of 895.65 mg/g at 400°C and 35 wt% H3PO4, corresponding to an estimated specific surface area of ~ 1490 m²/g. An extensive washing protocol reduced residual acidity from the activating agent, resulting in a purified adsorbent with a near-neutral pH (7.0 ± 0.1). Under simulated physiological conditions (0.031 mg/mL digoxin, 25°C), the synthesized AC demonstrated rapid, dose-dependent adsorption kinetics. At a dosage of 2 g, approximately 95% of digoxin was removed within 5 min, with residual concentrations approaching the analytical limit of detection (LOD). By 25–30 min, residual digoxin levels fell below the LOD, indicating a removal efficiency exceeding 95.5%. Under identical conditions, the commercial reference CARBOMIX showed 74–82% removal, compared with the prepared AC's apparent removal exceeding 95.5%. FTIR analysis confirmed the retention of oxygen-containing functional groups, while a point of zero charge (pHpzc) of 7.44 suggested a low net surface charge at physiological pH. Kinetic modeling revealed that adsorption data were best described by the non-linear pseudo-second-order model (R² > 0.99). With the exception of the CARBOMIX comparison, which was subsequently duplicated, all adsorption experiments were performed as single runs without replicates; therefore, the results should be regarded as exploratory and not statistically confirmed. These findings provide a preliminary proof-of-concept for walnut-shell-derived activated carbon as a potential adsorbent for digoxin removal from buffered solutions, warranting further investigation in more complex and physiologically relevant media.
full_list.abstract_zh: 为了探索用于地高辛净化的低成本候选吸附剂，本研究使用源自核桃壳生物质的活性炭（AC），通过食品级磷酸（H3PO4）活化，评估了模拟生理缓冲液（PBS，pH 7.4）中地高辛的吸附情况。制备条件的优化产生了在 400°C 和 35 wt% H3PO4 下最大碘值为 895.65 mg/g 的材料，对应于约 1490 m2/g 的估计比表面积。广泛的洗涤方案降低了活化剂的残留酸度，从而产生具有接近中性 pH 值 (7.0±0.1) 的纯化吸附剂。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 为了探索用于地高辛净化的低成本候选吸附剂，本研究使用源自核桃壳生物质的活性炭（AC），通过食品级磷酸（H3PO4）活化，评估了模拟生理缓冲液（PBS，pH 7.4）中地高辛的吸附情况。制备条件的优化产生了在 400°C 和 35 wt% H3PO4 下最大碘值为 895.65 mg/g 的材料，对应于约 1490 m2/g 的估计比表面积。广泛的洗涤方案降低了活化剂的残留酸度，从而产生具有接近中性 pH 值 (7.0±0.1) 的纯化吸附剂。在模拟生理条件下（0.031 mg/mL 地高辛，25°C），合成的 AC 表现出快速、剂量依赖性的吸附动力学。剂量为 2 g 时，约 95% 的地高辛在 5 分钟内被去除，残留浓度接近分析检测限 (LOD)。 25-30 分钟后，残留的地高辛水平降至 LOD 以下，表明去除效率超过 95.5%。在相同条件下，商业参考 CARBOMIX 显示出 74-82% 的去除率，而制备的 AC 的表观去除率超过 95.5%。 FTIR 分析证实了含氧官能团的保留，而 7.44 的零电荷点 (pHpzc) 表明在生理 pH 下净表面电荷较低。动力学模型表明，非线性伪二阶模型（R² > 0.99）可以最好地描述吸附数据。除了随后重复进行的 CARBOMIX 比较之外，所有吸附实验均作为单次运行进行，没有重复；因此，结果应被视为探索性的，而不是统计上证实的。这些发现为核桃壳衍生的活性炭作为从缓冲溶液中去除地高辛的潜在吸附剂提供了初步的概念验证，值得在更复杂和生理相关的介质中进行进一步研究。

full_list.title_en: Electrochemical Synthesis of Reduced Graphene Oxide Nanoparticles, Their MPS Functionalization and Their Effect on the Optical and Thermal Properties of a Non- Imprinted Methacrylic Polymer Nanocomposite
full_list.title_zh: 还原氧化石墨烯纳米颗粒的电化学合成、其 MPS 功能化及其对非印迹甲基丙烯酸聚合物纳米复合材料光学和热性能的影响
full_list.abstract: A novel electrochemical method was used to synthesize reduced graphene oxide nanoparticles (rGO NPs) from graphite electrodes in a mixture of sulfuric acid and phosphoric acid. The rGO was functionalized with 3-(trimethoxysilyl)propyl methacrylate (MPS) and the functionalized rGO was embedded in a methacrylic acid (MAA)/ethylene glycol dimethacrylate (EGDMA) matrix to create an rGO@MPS/NIP nanocomposite polymer (NCP). The reduced graphene oxide was found to contain few layer nanosheets with a crystallite size between 18 and 53 nm by X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis. The degree of purity (94.73% carbon, 4.94% oxygen and 0.32% sulfur) was confirmed by the energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) analysis, and the zeta potential was measured as -1.13 mV. After the surface was functionalized by MPS the EDX analysis showed the presence of silicon (0.40 wt%), and the zeta potential was shifted towards more negative value (-1.37 mV) confirming successful modification of the surface. The nanocomposite polymer (NCP) showed peaks in its XRD pattern between 13.9° and 68.7° with crystallite sizes of 19 to 54 nm. Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) showed that the onset of primary decomposition stage increased by 37.45°C from 179.70°C for the non-reinforced polymer (NIP) to 217.15°C for the reinforced polymer (NCP) and the temperature of maximum decomposition was relatively close (408.94°C versus 415.77°C). The results presented herein show that the MPS functionalized reduced graphene oxide is a good nanofiller to improve the optical and thermal properties of methacrylate polymers.
full_list.abstract_zh: 采用一种新颖的电化学方法在硫酸和磷酸的混合物中从石墨电极合成还原氧化石墨烯纳米颗粒（rGO NP）。 rGO用甲基丙烯酸3-(三甲氧基甲硅烷基)丙酯(MPS)功能化，并将功能化的rGO嵌入甲基丙烯酸(MAA)/二甲基丙烯酸乙二醇酯(EGDMA)基质中，形成rGO@MPS/NIP纳米复合聚合物(NCP)。通过 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 分析，发现还原的氧化石墨烯含有几层纳米片，微晶尺寸在 18 至 53 nm 之间。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 采用一种新颖的电化学方法在硫酸和磷酸的混合物中从石墨电极合成还原氧化石墨烯纳米颗粒（rGO NP）。 rGO用甲基丙烯酸3-(三甲氧基甲硅烷基)丙酯(MPS)功能化，并将功能化的rGO嵌入甲基丙烯酸(MAA)/二甲基丙烯酸乙二醇酯(EGDMA)基质中，形成rGO@MPS/NIP纳米复合聚合物(NCP)。通过 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 分析，发现还原的氧化石墨烯含有几层纳米片，微晶尺寸在 18 至 53 nm 之间。通过能量色散X射线（EDX）分析确认了纯度（94.73%碳、4.94%氧和0.32%硫），测得zeta电位为-1.13 mV。表面通过 MPS 功能化后，EDX 分析显示存在硅 (0.40 wt%)，并且 zeta 电位向更负值 (-1.37 mV) 移动，证实表面改性成功。纳米复合聚合物 (NCP) 在 XRD 图中显示出 13.9° 至 68.7° 之间的峰，微晶尺寸为 19 至 54 nm。热重分析（TGA）显示，初级分解阶段的起始温度从非增强聚合物（NIP）的179.70°C增加到增强聚合物（NCP）的217.15°C，增加了37.45°C，并且最大分解温度相对接近（408.94°C vs 415.77°C）。本文的结果表明，MPS 官能化还原氧化石墨烯是一种良好的纳米填料，可改善甲基丙烯酸酯聚合物的光学和热性能。

full_list.title_en: Endothelial Injury Associated with PFOA and PFOS Exposure: Insights from Network Toxicology and Experimental Validation
full_list.title_zh: 与 PFOA 和 PFOS 暴露相关的内皮损伤：来自网络毒理学和实验验证的见解
full_list.abstract: Background Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) and perfluorooctane sulfonate (PFOS) are persistent environmental contaminants that may affect vascular function. We combined network toxicology, molecular modeling, and human umbilical vein endothelial cell (HUVEC) assays to compare their predicted molecular interactions and short-term endothelial effects.Results Cross-referencing chemical-associated genes with six diabetic-complication gene sets identified JUN and TP53 as recurrent candidate nodes. Docking scores were similar, whereas 100-ns molecular dynamics and molecular mechanics Poisson–Boltzmann surface area (MM-PBSA) analyses showed lower whole-complex root mean square deviation (RMSD) and a more favorable estimated binding free energy for the PFOS–p53 model than for PFOA–p53. HUVECs were exposed to PFOA (50 µM), PFOS (50 µM), or their mixture (50 µM each). At 24 h, PFOS increased p-c-Jun/c-Jun and p-p65/p65 ratios, p53 and intercellular adhesion molecule 1 (ICAM-1) protein levels, and inflammatory gene expression, while reducing migration. All exposure conditions reduced junction numbers in a 12-h vascular-like network formation assay. The phosphorylated-to-total endothelial nitric oxide synthase (p-eNOS/eNOS) ratio was not significantly altered, and the mixture produced endpoint-dependent effects.Conclusions These results identify distinct short-term endothelial responses to PFOA and PFOS, with PFOS eliciting more pronounced inflammation-associated changes under the tested conditions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 背景全氟辛酸（PFOA）和全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）是可能影响血管功能的持久性环境污染物。我们结合网络毒理学、分子建模和人脐静脉内皮细胞 (HUVEC) 测定来比较它们预测的分子相互作用和短期内皮效应。结果将化学相关基因与六个糖尿病并发症基因集交叉引用，确定 JUN 和 TP53 为复发候选节点。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 背景全氟辛酸（PFOA）和全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）是可能影响血管功能的持久性环境污染物。我们结合网络毒理学、分子建模和人脐静脉内皮细胞 (HUVEC) 测定来比较它们预测的分子相互作用和短期内皮效应。结果将化学相关基因与六个糖尿病并发症基因集交叉引用，确定 JUN 和 TP53 为复发候选节点。对接分数相似，而 100 纳秒分子动力学和分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积 (MM-PBSA) 分析显示，与 PFOA-p53 相比，PFOS-p53 模型的整体复合物均方根偏差 (RMSD) 更低，估计结合自由能更有利。 HUVEC 暴露于 PFOA (50 µM)、PFOS (50 µM) 或其混合物（每种 50 µM）。 24 小时时，PFOS 增加了 p-c-Jun/c-Jun 和 p-p65/p65 比率、p53 和细胞间粘附分子 1 (ICAM-1) 蛋白水平以及炎症基因表达，同时减少迁移。在 12 小时血管样网络形成测定中，所有暴露条件都会减少连接数量。磷酸化内皮一氧化氮合酶 (p-eNOS/eNOS) 与总内皮一氧化氮合酶 (p-eNOS/eNOS) 的比率没有显着改变，并且混合物产生了终点依赖性效应。 结论 这些结果确定了对 PFOA 和 PFOS 的不同短期内皮反应，其中 PFOS 在测试条件下引发更明显的炎症相关变化。
full_list.summary: 背景全氟辛酸（PFOA）和全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）是可能影响血管功能的持久性环境污染物。我们结合网络毒理学、分子建模和人脐静脉内皮细胞 (HUVEC) 测定来比较它们预测的分子相互作用和短期内皮效应。结果将化学相关基因与六个糖尿病并发症基因集交叉引用，确定 JUN 和 TP53 为复发候选节点。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹, 自由能面和热力学积分/采样，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《与 PFOA 和 PFOS 暴露相关的内皮损伤：来自网络毒理学和实验验证的见解》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Evaluation of Water Quality of the Benso Reclaimated Acid Mine Drainage Site in the Mpohor District
full_list.title_zh: Mpohor地区Benso再生酸性矿山排水场水质评价
full_list.abstract: Extraction industry in Ghana is one of the most economically viable industry fetching huge returns to the country. However, over the years, the expansion of the extraction sector in Ghana have been associated with several social and environmental implications while environmental accidents from mines cost the country human lives and huge sums of money for rectification or remediation. Thus, the problem of acid mine drainage goes far beyond the existence of mining. Thus, after the official closure of a mine, the issue lingers on for long with negative implications existing for years. The study analyzed physico-chemical parameters of surface and ground water samples at Subriso, East Waste dump for Golden Star Wassa Limited to establish effectiveness of the Acid Mine Drainage (AMD) remediation method employed. Samples were collected from two major sources namely Surface flow (at 0 m) and Borehole (at 5 m and 10 m height). Electrical conductivity (EC) and pH were determined on the field by the pH meter and HANNA multi-parameter H19813–06 apparatus. Atomic Absorption Spectrometry (AAS) was utilized in analyzing heavy metals. Onsite results revealed that pH values of all waters analyzed fell within drinking water standards. Chemical analysis on samples showed that heavy metals such as Sulfate (SO4), Nitrate (NO3), Cadmium (Cd), Copper (Cu), Lead (Pb), Chromium (Cr), Mercury (Hg) and Nickle (Ni) within the upstream were good for drinking water except Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2 ) and Phosphate (PO4). The study found out that shallow boreholes analyzed had heavy metal concentrations, falling within the drinking water standards except PO4 which fell outside of range. For deep boreholes, all the metals analyzed fell within drinking water standards except Copper (Cu) which was not analyzed and PO4 which fell outside of range. Sulfate concentrations (SO4) decreased at (10 m) for deep boreholes, (0 m) for surface water and (5 m) for shallow boreholes. The study concluded that Sulfate (SO4) concentrations in the water samples analyzed increased after the remediation; therefore, the AMD remediation was unsuccessful.
full_list.abstract_zh: 加纳的采掘业是最具经济可行性的行业之一，为该国带来了丰厚的回报。然而，多年来，加纳采矿业的扩张带来了一些社会和环境影响，而矿山环境事故则给该国造成了人员伤亡和巨额资金用于整改或补救。由此可见，酸性矿井排水问题远远超出了采矿存在的范围。因此，在矿井正式关闭后，这个问题长期存在，负面影响持续多年。该研究分析了 Golden Star Wassa Limited 东垃圾场 Subriso 的地表水和地下水样品的物理化学参数，以确定所采用的酸性矿山排水 (AMD) 修复方法的有效性。

full_list.title_en: Experimental and Numerical Investigation of Microstructural Evolution, Mechanical Behaviour and Fracture Characteristics of Autogenous GTAW-Welded Duplex Stainless Steel 2205
full_list.title_zh: 自熔 GTAW 焊接双相不锈钢 2205 的显微组织演变、力学行为和断裂特性的实验和数值研究
full_list.abstract: This research paper examines microstructure evolution, mechanical properties and fracture behavior of 2 mm thin Duplex Stainless Steels (DSS 2205) plate joint through the process of Autogenous Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (GTAW). Microstructural analysis of base metal (BM), heat affected zone (HAZ) and weld zone (WZ) is done using optical microscopy and quantitative Phase Analysis. The ferrite percentages are 48.4% in BM, 50.2% in HAZ to 51.7% in WZ while the austenite percentages reduced from 51.6% in BM to 49.8% in HAZ and 48.3% in WZ respectively. Microchemical composition analysis is done using scanning electron microscope-energy dispersive spectroscopy and found that there is compositional segregation in the two microstructural phases. Microhardness of the BM, HAZ and WZ are 221.25 HV, 231.67 HV and 239 HV, respectively, indicating an 8.0% increase in WZ hardness relative to the BM. Tensile testing on the BM and the welded specimens provided ultimate tensile strengths of 766 MPa and 762 MPa, indicating 99.48% retention of tensile strength. Analysis of the stress-strain plot indicates that the area under the curve up to the UTS is decreased by 13.24% and the entire area over the range of data is decreased by 3.42% in the welded specimen. SEM fractography indicated predominance of ductile fracture features including fine and large dimples, micro voids and interdimple ligaments, which indicate microvoid nucleation, growth and coalescence of the fractured surfaces. Abaqus/Explicit FEM provided maximum von Mises stress values of 277.1 MPa and 264.8 MPa for the BM and welded samples, respectively, which is a decrease of 4.44% in the maximum numerical contour.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究论文通过自气体保护钨极电弧焊 (GTAW) 工艺研究了 2 毫米薄双相不锈钢 (DSS 2205) 板接头的微观结构演变、机械性能和断裂行为。使用光学显微镜和定量相分析对母材 (BM)、热影响区 (HAZ) 和焊接区 (WZ) 进行微观结构分析。 BM 中的铁素体百分比为 48.4%，HAZ 中为 50.2%，WZ 中为 51.7%，而奥氏体百分比分别从 BM 中的 51.6% 降至 HAZ 中的 49.8% 和 WZ 中的 48.3%。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本研究论文通过自气体保护钨极电弧焊 (GTAW) 工艺研究了 2 毫米薄双相不锈钢 (DSS 2205) 板接头的微观结构演变、机械性能和断裂行为。使用光学显微镜和定量相分析对母材 (BM)、热影响区 (HAZ) 和焊接区 (WZ) 进行微观结构分析。 BM 中的铁素体百分比为 48.4%，HAZ 中为 50.2%，WZ 中为 51.7%，而奥氏体百分比分别从 BM 中的 51.6% 降至 HAZ 中的 49.8% 和 WZ 中的 48.3%。使用扫描电子显微镜-能量色散光谱进行微化学成分分析，发现两个微观结构相中存在成分偏析。 BM、HAZ和WZ的显微硬度分别为221.25 HV、231.67 HV和239 HV，表明WZ硬度相对于BM增加了8.0%。 BM 和焊接样本的拉伸测试提供了 766 MPa 和 762 MPa 的极限拉伸强度，表明拉伸强度保留率为 99.48%。对应力-应变图的分析表明，在焊接样本中，直到 UTS 的曲线下面积减少了 13.24%，数据范围内的整个面积减少了 3.42%。 SEM 断口显示主要是韧性断裂特征，包括细小和大的韧窝、微空隙和韧窝间韧带，这表明微空隙成核、生长和断裂表面的聚结。 Abaqus/Explicit FEM 为 BM 和焊接样品提供的最大 von Mises 应力值分别为 277.1 MPa 和 264.8 MPa，最大数值轮廓降低了 4.44%。

full_list.title_en: Geological Controls on PFAS Migration in Deltaic Aquifer Systems: Integrating Sediment Geochemistry, Hydrostratigraphy and Groundwater Vulnerability in Dhaka, Bangladesh
full_list.title_zh: 对三角洲含水层系统中 PFAS 迁移的地质控制：综合孟加拉国达卡的沉积物地球化学、水文地层学和地下水脆弱性
full_list.abstract: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances are persistent fluorinated contaminants whose behavior in the subsurface of densely populated deltaic aquifers remains poorly constrained, particularly where low sediment organic carbon, heterogeneous fluvio-deltaic stratigraphy, and intensive groundwater abstraction coincide. This study quantifies the depth-dependent distribution of four regulated PFAS (perfluorobutanoic acid, PFBA; perfluorohexanesulfonate, PFHxS; perfluorooctanoic acid, PFOA; and perfluorooctanesulfonate, PFOS) across ten monitoring locations in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and evaluates the extent to which lithofacies, sediment geochemistry, and hydrostratigraphic boundaries regulate vertical migration and deep aquifer vulnerability. Depth-discrete groundwater samples were collected from the ground surface to depths exceeding 120 m, analyzed by solid-phase extraction and liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry, partitioned against a four-unit hydrostratigraphic framework, and modeled with non-parametric generalized additive models to resolve the vertical concentration structure. Cumulative Σ4PFAS spans three orders of magnitude and follows an asymmetric bell-shaped profile. Concentrations rise from the immediate surface layer, reach a modeled maximum between 25 and 35 m below ground surface, decline through an inflection in the deeper profile, and stabilize at baseline values below 50 ng/L in the basal interval beneath approximately 120 m. Median Σ4PFAS decreases systematically across hydrostratigraphic boundaries: 1,100 ng/L in the fine sand Upper Shallow Aquifer (0 to 30 m), 550 ng/L in the clay and silt Upper Aquitard (30 to 50 m), 70 ng/L in the silty clay Middle Aquitard (50 to 80 m), and below 30 ng/L in the medium to coarse sand Deep Main Aquifer (greater than 80 m). PFOS is the largest single mass contributor, whereas PFBA peaks at the shallowest depth and persists furthest into the deeper profile, consistent with chain-length dependent sorption and air-water interfacial retention. Spatial medians decline from Savar (980 ng/L), Demra (950 ng/L), Tejgaon Industrial Area (880 ng/L), and Mirpur (810 ng/L) through Uttara (680 ng/L), Motijheel (530 ng/L), Tongi (360 ng/L), and Gulshan (320 ng/L) to Narayanganj (80 ng/L) and Keraniganj (40 ng/L), tracking industrial land use. The results demonstrate that fine-grained aquitards currently shield the deep supply aquifer, but that the accumulation zone between 25 and 35 m constitutes a persistent, pumping-sensitive reservoir of mobile short-chain mass.
full_list.abstract_zh: 全氟烷基和多氟烷基物质是持久性氟化污染物，其在人口稠密的三角洲含水层地下的行为仍然受到很少的限制，特别是在低沉积物有机碳、异质河流三角洲地层和密集地下水抽取同时发生的情况下。本研究量化了孟加拉国达卡十个监测地点四种受管制 PFAS（全氟丁酸，PFBA；全氟己烷磺酸盐，PFHxS；全氟辛酸，PFOA；和全氟辛烷磺酸盐，PFOS）随深度的分布，并评估了岩相、沉积物地球化学和水文地层边界调节垂直迁移和深层含水层脆弱性的程度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 全氟烷基和多氟烷基物质是持久性氟化污染物，其在人口稠密的三角洲含水层地下的行为仍然受到很少的限制，特别是在低沉积物有机碳、异质河流三角洲地层和密集地下水抽取同时发生的情况下。本研究量化了孟加拉国达卡十个监测地点四种受管制 PFAS（全氟丁酸，PFBA；全氟己烷磺酸盐，PFHxS；全氟辛酸，PFOA；和全氟辛烷磺酸盐，PFOS）随深度的分布，并评估了岩相、沉积物地球化学和水文地层边界调节垂直迁移和深层含水层脆弱性的程度。从地表采集深度超过120 m的深度离散地下水样品，通过固相萃取和液相色谱串联质谱分析，根据四单元水文地层框架进行划分，并使用非参数广义加性模型进行建模，以解析垂直浓度结构。累积 Σ4PFAS 跨越三个数量级，并遵循不对称的钟形轮廓。浓度从直接表面层上升，在地表以下 25 至 35 m 之间达到模拟最大值，通过更深剖面的拐点下降，并在约 120 m 以下的基底层段中稳定在低于 50 ng/L 的基线值。 Σ4PFAS 中值在水文地层边界上系统性地降低：细砂上部浅层含水层（0 至 30 m）为 1,100 ng/L，粘土和粉砂上部浅层含水层（30 至 50 m）为 550 ng/L，粉质粘土中层浅层（50 至 80 m）为 70 ng/L，中层至浅层含水层为 30 ng/L 以下。粗砂深层主含水层（大于80 m）。 PFOS 是最大的单一质量贡献者，而 PFBA 在最浅深度达到峰值，并在更深的剖面中持续存在最远，这与链长依赖性吸附和空气-水界面保留一致。空间中位数从 Savar (980 ng/L)、Demra (950 ng/L)、Tejgaon 工业区 (880 ng/L) 和 Mirpur (810 ng/L) 到 Uttara (680 ng/L)、Motijheel (530 ng/L)、Tongi (360 ng/L) 和 Gulshan (320 ng/L) 下降到Narayanganj (80 ng/L) 和 Keraniganj (40 ng/L)，跟踪工业用地使用情况。结果表明，细粒弱透水层目前屏蔽了深层供水含水层，但 25 至 35 m 之间的聚集区构成了一个持久的、对抽水敏感的移动短链物质储层。

full_list.title_en: Hydrogenation of carbon dioxide to formic acid over HZSM-5 zeolites modified with single-atom Rh and Mg
full_list.title_zh: 单原子 Rh 和 Mg 改性 HZSM-5 沸石上二氧化碳加氢制甲酸
full_list.abstract: Direct hydrogenation of CO2 to formic acid represents a promising strategy for carbon capture and utilization. For the first time, commercially available HZSM-5 zeolites (Si/Al ~ 15–18) were systematically studied as heterogeneous catalysts for this reaction under mild conditions. In a water-triethylamine medium at 60–150°C, all catalysts exhibited nearly 100% formic acid selectivity, with yields strongly governed by acidity and mesoporosity. Bimetallic Rh-Mg catalysts demonstrated a pronounced synergistic effect, yielding up to 5100 µmol·g–1 at 150°C, which is 7–17% higher than Rh alone and 1.6–3.7 times higher than Mg alone. The synergy originates from the close proximity of Rh and Mg, where adjacent Mg cations promote CO2 adsorption and stabilizes intermediate formate species, preventing their decomposition at elevated temperatures. Controlled desilication further improved mesoporosity and active-site accessibility, increasing the yield to 5600 µmol·g–1. Notably, retaining polyvinylpyrrolidone on the catalyst surface eliminated the requirement for an external amine, as it acts as a built‑in base. The optimized Rh-Mg/PVP/HZdes catalyst achieved the highest yield of 5780 µmol·g–1.
full_list.abstract_zh: CO2 直接加氢生成甲酸是碳捕获和利用的一种有前景的策略。首次系统研究了商用 HZSM-5 沸石 (Si/Al ~ 15–18) 作为温和条件下该反应的多相催化剂。在 60-150°C 的水-三乙胺介质中，所有催化剂都表现出接近 100% 的甲酸选择性，产率很大程度上取决于酸度和介孔率。双金属Rh-Mg催化剂表现出显着的协同效应，在150°C时产量高达5100 µmol·g–1，比单独的Rh高7-17%，比单独的Mg高1.6-3.7倍。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: CO2 直接加氢生成甲酸是碳捕获和利用的一种有前景的策略。首次系统研究了商用 HZSM-5 沸石 (Si/Al ~ 15–18) 作为温和条件下该反应的多相催化剂。在 60-150°C 的水-三乙胺介质中，所有催化剂都表现出接近 100% 的甲酸选择性，产率很大程度上取决于酸度和介孔率。双金属Rh-Mg催化剂表现出显着的协同效应，在150°C时产量高达5100 µmol·g–1，比单独的Rh高7-17%，比单独的Mg高1.6-3.7倍。这种协同作用源于 Rh 和 Mg 的接近，其中相邻的 Mg 阳离子促进 CO2 吸附并稳定中间甲酸盐物质，防止其在高温下分解。受控脱硅进一步提高了介孔性和活性位点可达性，将产量提高至 5600 µmol·g–1。值得注意的是，将聚乙烯吡咯烷酮保留在催化剂表面上消除了对外部胺的需求，因为它充当内置碱。优化后的Rh-Mg/PVP/HZdes催化剂实现了最高收率5780 µmol·g–1。

full_list.title_en: Limited Intrinsic CO₂/CH₄ Selectivity in Imine-Linked COF-LZU- 1: Evidence from PBE-D3 Adsorption Energetics and Binary- Mixture Monte Carlo Simulations
full_list.title_zh: 亚胺连接的 COF-LZU-1 中有限的固有 CO2/CH4 选择性：来自 PBE-D3 吸附能量学和二元混合物蒙特卡罗模拟的证据
full_list.abstract: Imine-linked covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are widely proposed for CO₂/CH₄ separation, yet the intrinsic selectivity of the archetypal framework COF-LZU1 has not been quantified against a transparent baseline. Here, periodic PBE-D3 calculations and grand canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) simulations are combined to test whether pristine COF-LZU1 discriminates between CO₂ and CH₄. At three positions spanning the 1.8 nm channel, relaxed PBE-D3 adsorption energies are − 3.10, − 3.66, and − 8.90 kJ mol⁻¹ for CO₂ and − 3.13, − 3.63, and − 8.76 kJ mol⁻¹ for CH₄; CO₂ binds more strongly than CH₄ by at most 0.14 kJ mol⁻¹, at the confined site near the imine linkage. Consistently, GCMC simulations of equimolar mixtures (TraPPE, DREIDING, DDEC6 charges, Ewald electrostatics, 14 Å cutoff with analytic tail corrections) give low selectivities of 1.15–1.71 between 273 and 323 K and 0.1–10 bar, and 1.20–1.38 at 298 K, rising with pressure and falling with temperature. At 223 K and 7–10 bar, CO₂ fills about 80% of the pore volume and the selectivity reaches about 11, a pore-filling effect and not intrinsic discrimination. Replacing EPM2 CO₂, a 12 Å cutoff, and no tail corrections by the final force-field set raises the selectivity by 7–27%, so selectivities near unity are force-field sensitive. The weak simulated selectivity, together with the near-equal DFT binding energies, defines a baseline that functionalization, for example with Ag⁺, must overcome.
full_list.abstract_zh: 亚胺连接的共价有机框架 (COF) 被广泛提议用于 CO2/CH4 分离，但原型框架 COF-LZU1 的内在选择性尚未根据透明基线进行量化。在这里，定期 PBE-D3 计算和大正则蒙特卡罗 (GCMC) 模拟相结合，测试原始 COF-LZU1 是否能够区分 CO2 和 CH4。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 亚胺连接的共价有机框架 (COF) 被广泛提议用于 CO2/CH4 分离，但原型框架 COF-LZU1 的内在选择性尚未根据透明基线进行量化。在这里，定期 PBE-D3 计算和大正则蒙特卡罗 (GCMC) 模拟相结合，测试原始 COF-LZU1 是否能够区分 CO2 和 CH4。在跨越 1.8 nm 通道的三个位置上，CO2 的松弛 PBE-D3 吸附能分别为 - 3.10、- 3.66 和 - 8.90 kJ mol⁻1，CH4 的松弛 PBE-D3 吸附能分别为 - 3.13、- 3.63 和 - 8.76 kJ mol⁻1；在亚胺键附近的限制位点，CO 2 的结合力比 CH 4 的结合力最多强 0.14 kJ mol -1 。一致地，等摩尔混合物的 GCMC 模拟（TraPPE、DREIDING、DDEC6 电荷、Ewald 静电、带有分析尾部修正的 14 Å 截止值）在 273 至 323 K 和 0.1-10 bar 之间给出了 1.15-1.71 的低选择性，在 298 K 下给出了 1.20-1.38 的低选择性，随压力升高而随温度降低。在 223 K 和 7-10 bar 下，CO2 填充了约 80% 的孔体积，选择性达到约 11，这是一种孔填充效应，而不是内在歧视。将 EPM2 CO2 替换为 12 Å 截止值，且最终力场集无尾部修正，可将选择性提高 7-27%，因此接近 1 的选择性对力场敏感。弱的模拟选择性以及接近相等的 DFT 结合能定义了功能化（例如 Ag⁺）必须克服的基线。
full_list.summary: 亚胺连接的共价有机框架 (COF) 被广泛提议用于 CO2/CH4 分离，但原型框架 COF-LZU1 的内在选择性尚未根据透明基线进行量化。在这里，定期 PBE-D3 计算和大正则蒙特卡罗 (GCMC) 模拟相结合，测试原始 COF-LZU1 是否能够区分 CO2 和 CH4。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《亚胺连接的 COF-LZU-1 中有限的固有 CO2/CH4 选择性：来自 PBE-D3 吸附能量学和二元混合物蒙特卡罗模拟的证据》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Overexpression of jasmonate-responsive OsHLH46 results in the induction of bacterial blight-resistance in rice
full_list.title_zh: 茉莉酸响应性 OsHLH46 的过度表达导致水稻白叶枯病抗性的诱导
full_list.abstract: The phytohormone jasmonic acid (JA) serves as a key signaling molecule in plant defense responses and development, with its signaling tightly regulated by various transcription factors (TFs). Here, we report that the atypical basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH)-type TF, OsHLH46, plays an important role in the JA-mediated resistance response against rice bacterial blight caused by Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae. The expression of OsHLH46 was upregulated by JA but not by salicylic or abscisic acids. OsHLH46 formed a homodimer, but did not interact with any of the Jasmonate ZIM-domain (JAZ) proteins or other JA-responsive bHLH-type TFs. Transgenic rice plants overexpressing OsHLH46 exhibited a JA-hypersensitive phenotype and increased resistance against rice bacterial blight. The expression of several cytosol-localized peroxidases as well as that of OsWRKY45 was upregulated in OsHLH46-overexpressing rice plants. Furthermore, these plants exhibited high tolerance to hydrogen peroxide. These results revealed that OsHLH46 is an important regulator of the JA-mediated defense response in rice.

full_list.title_en: Preparation of Sn/Na-Co3O4 Nanospheres for Improved Triethylamine Sensing Performance Research
full_list.title_zh: Sn/Na-Co3O4 纳米球的制备用于改进三乙胺传感性能研究
full_list.abstract: Here, a series of Sn/Na co-doped Co3O4 nanospheres are synthesized by a one-step solvothermal method. The gas sensing performance of Co3O4-based nanospheres toward triethylamine is investigated in detail. The optimal operating temperature of 1%Sn5%Na-Co3O4 nanospheres to 100 ppm triethylamine is lower 20 ℃ than that of pure Co3O4. Compared with pure Co3O4, the response of 1%Sn5%Na-Co3O4 nanospheres is increased by approximately 7.2 times. Furthermore, the 1%Sn5%Na-Co3O4 sensor exhibits better anti-humidity and lower detection limit. At last, the possible gas mechanism is discussed according to the modulation of the Co3O4 microstructure and surface chemistry by co-doping Sn/Na. Therefore, the Sn/Na-Co3O4 nanospheres offer new insights for the design of triethylamine sensors and provide potential application in food safety monitoring and the early detection of fish spoilage.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文通过一步溶剂热法合成了一系列 Sn/Na 共掺杂 Co3O4 纳米球。详细研究了 Co3O4 基纳米球对三乙胺的气敏性能。 1%Sn5%Na-Co3O4纳米球对100 ppm三乙胺的最佳操作温度比纯Co3O4低20℃。与纯Co3O4相比，1%Sn5%Na-Co3O4纳米球的响应提高了约7.2倍。此外，1%Sn5%Na-Co3O4传感器具有更好的抗湿性和更低的检测限。最后，根据Sn/Na共掺杂对Co3O4微观结构和表面化学的调节，讨论了可能的气体机理。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本文通过一步溶剂热法合成了一系列 Sn/Na 共掺杂 Co3O4 纳米球。详细研究了 Co3O4 基纳米球对三乙胺的气敏性能。 1%Sn5%Na-Co3O4纳米球对100 ppm三乙胺的最佳操作温度比纯Co3O4低20℃。与纯Co3O4相比，1%Sn5%Na-Co3O4纳米球的响应提高了约7.2倍。此外，1%Sn5%Na-Co3O4传感器具有更好的抗湿性和更低的检测限。最后，根据Sn/Na共掺杂对Co3O4微观结构和表面化学的调节，讨论了可能的气体机理。因此，Sn/Na-Co3O4纳米球为三乙胺传感器的设计提供了新的见解，并为食品安全监测和鱼类腐败的早期检测提供了潜在的应用。

full_list.title_en: Process Synthesis, Simulation and Optimization of Light Components Separation from Furfural Production
full_list.title_zh: 糠醛生产中轻组分分离工艺合成、模拟与优化
full_list.abstract: The light components from furfural production consist of furfural, methanol, acetone and methyl acetate. Currently, these valuable chemical components in the furfural production tail gas are directly incinerated or vented, leading to environmental pollution and resource waste. Therefore recovering these chemicals is of great practical significance. Five schemes are synthesized and optimized for separating the light components by extractive distillation employing water, ethylene glycol, dimethyl sulfoxide and furfural as extractants, respectively, using Aspen Plus V15. The advantages and disadvantages of the five schemes are compared and discussed in terms of recovery and purity, energy consumption and column efficiency. This study may provide a valuable reference for furfural manufacturers to recover the light components.
full_list.abstract_zh: 糠醛生产中的轻质组分包括糠醛、甲醇、丙酮和乙酸甲酯。目前，糠醛生产尾气中这些有价值的化学成分均直接焚烧或排放，造成环境污染和资源浪费。因此回收这些化学品具有重要的现实意义。采用Aspen Plus V15，合成并优化了分别以水、乙二醇、二甲亚砜和糠醛为萃取剂的萃取精馏分离轻组分的五种方案。从回收率和纯度、能耗和塔效等方面对五种方案的优缺点进行了比较和讨论。本研究可为糠醛生产企业回收轻组分提供有价值的参考。

full_list.title_en: Raw jujube stone and raw hawthorn stone particles as green adsorbents for the adsorption of different organic dyes
full_list.title_zh: 原枣核、原山楂石颗粒作为绿色吸附剂，用于吸附不同的有机染料
full_list.abstract: In this work, the raw jujube stone particles (RJSP) and the raw hawthorn stone particles (RHSP) as efficient natural and green adsorbents were used for the adsorption of methylene blue (MB), malachite green (MG), crystal violet (CV), and disperse red 1 (DR1) dyes. The functional groups, morphology, particle size, surface area, and pore size of RJSP and RHSP were determined using FT-IR, BET, FESEM, TEM, and EDX. The green adsorbents RJSP and RHSP showed high efficiency in the adsorption of MB, MG, CV, and DR1 dyes and showed comparable performance to other reported adsorbents. According to the results, the adsorption of MB, MG, CV, and DR1 dyes onto RJSP and RHSP follows the Freundlich isotherm, while the kinetics are well described by the pseudo-second-order model. Also, according to the Langmuir isotherm, RJSP exhibited maximum adsorption capacities (Qm) of 145, 124, 114, and 98 mg/g for MB, MG, CV, and DR1, respectively, while RHSP showed adsorption capacities of 84, 111, 102, and 94 mg/g. In addition, thermodynamic parameters confirm that the adsorption of MB, MG, CV, and DR1 dyes is exothermic on RJSP and endothermic on RHSP. Finally, the RJSP and RHSP can be used as affordable, environmentally friendly, and effective natural adsorbents for the removal of various industrial dyes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本工作采用原枣核颗粒（RJSP）和原山楂核颗粒（RHSP）作为高效的天然绿色吸附剂，用于吸附亚甲基蓝（MB）、孔雀石绿（MG）、结晶紫（CV）和分散红1（DR1）染料。使用 FT-IR、BET、FESEM、TEM 和 EDX 测定 RJSP 和 RHSP 的官能团、形态、粒径、表面积和孔径。绿色吸附剂 RJSP 和 RHSP 对 MB、MG、CV 和 DR1 染料的吸附效率很高，并且与其他报道的吸附剂表现出可比的性能。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本工作采用原枣核颗粒（RJSP）和原山楂核颗粒（RHSP）作为高效的天然绿色吸附剂，用于吸附亚甲基蓝（MB）、孔雀石绿（MG）、结晶紫（CV）和分散红1（DR1）染料。使用 FT-IR、BET、FESEM、TEM 和 EDX 测定 RJSP 和 RHSP 的官能团、形态、粒径、表面积和孔径。绿色吸附剂 RJSP 和 RHSP 对 MB、MG、CV 和 DR1 染料的吸附效率很高，并且与其他报道的吸附剂表现出可比的性能。结果表明，MB、MG、CV和DR1染料在RJSP和RHSP上的吸附遵循Freundlich等温线，并且动力学可以通过伪二阶模型很好地描述。此外，根据 Langmuir 等温线，RJSP 对 MB、MG、CV 和 DR1 的最大吸附容量 (Qm) 分别为 145、124、114 和 98 mg/g，而 RHSP 显示的吸附容量为 84、111、102 和 94 mg/g。此外，热力学参数证实MB、MG、CV和DR1染料的吸附在RJSP上是放热的，在RHSP上是吸热的。最后，RJSP和RHSP可以作为经济、环保、有效的天然吸附剂用于去除各种工业染料。
full_list.summary: 本工作采用原枣核颗粒（RJSP）和原山楂核颗粒（RHSP）作为高效的天然绿色吸附剂，用于吸附亚甲基蓝（MB）、孔雀石绿（MG）、结晶紫（CV）和分散红1（DR1）染料。使用 FT-IR、BET、FESEM、TEM 和 EDX 测定 RJSP 和 RHSP 的官能团、形态、粒径、表面积和孔径。绿色吸附剂 RJSP 和 RHSP 对 MB、MG、CV 和 DR1 染料的吸附效率很高，并且与其他报道的吸附剂表现出可比的性能。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《原枣核、原山楂石颗粒作为绿色吸附剂，用于吸附不同的有机染料》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: T4 Bacteriophage-Inspired Six-Legged Optical Fiber Sensor for Sensitive and Robust Micro-Airflow Detection
full_list.title_zh: T4 受噬菌体启发的六足光纤传感器，用于灵敏且稳定的微气流检测
full_list.abstract: Micro-airflow sensing requires high sensitivity and mechanical robustness, but conventional diaphragm- or cantilever-based fiber probes struggle to excel in both. Here, we report a T4 bacteriophage-inspired six-legged fiber-optic Fabry–Pérot (F-P) sensor. Six flexible tail fibers act as the elastic supporting legs, the baseplate serves as the F-P reflector, and the head acts as a wind catcher. The entire probe is printed in a single step onto a fiber end face using femtosecond two-photon polymerization. The optimized cavity length is 22 µm, the tail-fiber width and thickness are both 3 µm, and the included angles are 60° and 85 °, respectively. The sensor responds linearly from 4 to 355 sccm, with a sensitivity of − 0.099 nm/sccm, a detection limit of 4 sccm, and a resolution of 0.002 sccm. The response and recovery times are 8 ms and 3 ms, respectively. After a 15 µm compression impact, the probe recovers elastically, whereas a conventional cantilever deforms irreversibly. The load-sharing design of six legs combines high sensitivity with high toughness, and the results reveal a new route for micro-flow metering, breath monitoring, and turbulence warning.
full_list.abstract_zh: 微气流传感需要高灵敏度和机械鲁棒性，但传统的基于隔膜或悬臂梁的光纤探头很难在这两方面表现出色。在这里，我们报告了一种受 T4 噬菌体启发的六足光纤法布里-珀罗 (F-P) 传感器。六根柔性尾部纤维作为弹性支撑腿，底板作为F-P反射器，头部作为捕风器。使用飞秒双光子聚合将整个探针一步打印到光纤端面上。优化后的腔长为22 µm，尾纤宽度和厚度均为3 µm，夹角分别为60°和85°。

full_list.title_en: Antimicrobial activity of açaí (Euterpe oleracea Mart.) seed pyrolysis bio-oil against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus: in vitro assays and a wounded human organotypic skin explant (hOSEC) model
full_list.title_zh: 阿萨伊 (Euterpe oleracea Mart.) 种子热解生物油对耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌的抗菌活性：体外测定和受伤的人体器官型皮肤外植体 (hOSEC) 模型
full_list.abstract: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) causes skin and soft-tissue infections, and new topical agents are needed. Açaí (Euterpe oleracea Mart.) seeds are an Amazonian agro-industrial residue whose pyrolysis bio-oil is rich in phenolic compounds. This study evaluated açaí bio-oil against S. aureus in vitro and in the human organotypic skin explant culture model (hOSEC). Bio-oils were obtained by pyrolysis of 1 M NaOH-impregnated açaí seeds at 350, 400, and 450°C and characterised for acid value, density, and viscosity. Cytotoxicity was assessed by MTT assay in NIH-3T3 fibroblasts and HaCaT keratinocytes; minimum inhibitory and bactericidal concentrations (MIC/MBC) against MRSA NCTC 12493 by resazurin microdilution; reactive oxygen species (ROS) by H2DCFH-DA fluorescence; tissue tolerability by TTC assay in hOSEC; and topical antibacterial activity in wounded hOSEC colonised with S. aureus ATCC BAA-1026. MIC and MBC were 1000 µg/mL for the 350°C bio-oil and 500 µg/mL for the 400 and 450°C bio-oils, indicating weak-to-moderate bactericidal activity. Monolayer CC50 values (115.5–305.3 µg/mL) were below the MICs (selectivity index 0.13–0.37), whereas skin explants showed greater tolerance (CC50 > 1000 µg/mL; viability ≥ 53% at 1000 µg/mL after 120 h). In wounded hOSEC, the 350°C and 450°C bio-oils at 1000 µg/mL reduced S. aureus counts to near the detection limit at 24 h, outperforming the antibiotic–antimycotic control (p = 0.0483 and p = 0.0446). Açaí seed bio-oil exhibits bactericidal activity against MRSA and is tolerated by skin tissue at effective concentrations, supporting its potential as a topical antimicrobial.
full_list.abstract_zh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌 (MRSA) 会引起皮肤和软组织感染，因此需要新的外用制剂。阿萨伊 (Euterpe oleracea Mart.) 种子是亚马逊农工业残留物，其热解生物油富含酚类化合物。本研究在体外和人类器官型皮肤外植体培养模型 (hOSEC) 中评估了巴西莓生物油对金黄色葡萄球菌的抵抗力。通过在 350、400 和 450°C 下热解 1 M NaOH 浸渍的巴西莓种子获得生物油，并对其酸值、密度和粘度进行表征。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌 (MRSA) 会引起皮肤和软组织感染，因此需要新的外用制剂。阿萨伊 (Euterpe oleracea Mart.) 种子是亚马逊农工业残留物，其热解生物油富含酚类化合物。本研究在体外和人类器官型皮肤外植体培养模型 (hOSEC) 中评估了巴西莓生物油对金黄色葡萄球菌的抵抗力。通过在 350、400 和 450°C 下热解 1 M NaOH 浸渍的巴西莓种子获得生物油，并对其酸值、密度和粘度进行表征。通过 MTT 法评估 NIH-3T3 成纤维细胞和 HaCaT 角质形成细胞的细胞毒性；刃天青微量稀释对 MRSA NCTC 12493 的最低抑制和杀菌浓度 (MIC/MBC)； H2DCFH-DA 荧光检测活性氧 (ROS)； hOSEC 中 TTC 测定的组织耐受性；以及金黄色葡萄球菌 ATCC BAA-1026 定植的受伤 hOSEC 的局部抗菌活性。 350°C 生物油的 MIC 和 MBC 为 1000 µg/mL，400°C 和 450°C 生物油的 MIC 和 MBC 为 500 µg/mL，表明杀菌活性为弱至中度。单层 CC50 值 (115.5–305.3 µg/mL) 低于 MIC（选择性指数 0.13–0.37），而皮肤外植体表现出更高的耐受性（CC50 > 1000 µg/mL；120 小时后在 1000 µg/mL 下活力 ≥ 53%）。在受伤的 hOSEC 中，1000 µg/mL 的 350°C 和 450°C 生物油在 24 小时将金黄色葡萄球菌计数减少至接近检测限，优于抗生素抗真菌对照（p = 0.0483 和 p = 0.0446）。巴西莓种子生物油对 MRSA 具有杀菌活性，并且在有效浓度下能被皮肤组织耐受，这支持了其作为局部抗菌剂的潜力。

full_list.title_en: Converged moisture, not vapor transport, governs western United States mountain snowpack
full_list.title_zh: 控制美国西部山区积雪的是汇聚湿气，而不是水汽输送
full_list.abstract: A mountain range accumulates snow in proportion not to the water vapor transported past it but to how much is converged over it and falls frozen. Using a budget-derived seasonal moisture supply, Pb = −∇·Q + E, over seven western United States ranges, we show that once a daily surface-temperature filter separates snow from rain, this frozen convergence tracks basin peak snow water equivalent at r ≈ 0.69–0.92 — far outpredicting the integrated vapor transport emphasized in the atmospheric-river literature (mean r ≈ 0.26). The ocean state’s modulation of the converged supply sets the geography of predictability: the northern and coastal ranges’ supply is reconstructable out of sample from the concurrent sea-surface-temperature state — ENSO and an Atlantic “Quadpole” mode acting through a North Pacific cyclonic anomaly (cross-validated r ≈ 0.4–0.6) — whereas the Colorado-headwater interior is governed by a regional circulation the leading ocean modes do not reach.
full_list.abstract_zh: 山脉积雪的比例不是与输送经过它的水蒸气成比例，而是与汇聚在山上并结冰的水蒸气的数量成比例。使用预算得出的季节性水分供应，Pb = −∇·Q + E，在美国西部的七个范围内，我们表明，一旦每日表面温度过滤器将雪与雨分开，这种冻结的收敛跟踪盆地峰值雪水当量为 r ≈ 0.69–0.92 - 远远超过了大气河流文献中强调的综合水汽输送（平均值 r   0.26）。

full_list.title_en: Development and Psychometric Evaluation of Parallel Short Forms of the Compassion Questionnaires for Self and Others
full_list.title_zh: 自我和他人同情心问卷平行简表的开发和心理测量评估
full_list.abstract: Background: The revised Compassion Questionnaires for Self and Others provide parallel multidimensional assessments but contain 39 and 33 items, respectively. This study developed matched shorter forms using two Canadian adult samples.Methods: The parent sample was randomly divided into development and holdout subsets. Item selection considered domain coverage, redundancy, psychometric performance, and parent-form correspondence. Fixed configurations were evaluated in the holdout subsets and externally confirmed in an independent sample. Analyses examined factor structure, internal consistency, concurrent associations, gender invariance, and associations with Suffering and Overcoming.Results: The CQS-20 and CQO-20 retained three matched domains: Thinking/Feeling Compassionately, Connecting With Others Compassionately, and Acting Compassionately. Holdout analyses indicated acceptable fit for both forms. In the independent sample, the CQO-20 maintained acceptable fit, whereas the CQS-20 showed weaker CFI and TLI values but preserved its loading pattern. Internal consistency was strong, and concurrent associations followed directional patterns. The CQS-20 supported metric but not scalar invariance; the CQO-20 supported scalar but not strict invariance. Conditional inference trees identified Suffering as more prominent for self-compassion and Overcoming as more prominent for compassion toward others.Conclusions: The short forms reduce the battery from 72 to 40 items while retaining parallel multidimensional assessment. Stand-alone evaluation remains necessary.
full_list.abstract_zh: 背景：修订后的自我和他人同情心问卷提供了平行的多维评估，但分别包含 39 和 33 个项目。本研究使用两个加拿大成人样本开发了匹配的较短形式。方法：将父样本随机分为发育子集和保留子集。项目选择考虑了领域覆盖、冗余、心理测量表现和父形式对应。固定配置在保留子集中进行评估，并在独立样本中进行外部确认。分析检查了因素结构、内部一致性、并发关联、性别不变性以及与痛苦和克服的关联。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 背景：修订后的自我和他人同情心问卷提供了平行的多维评估，但分别包含 39 和 33 个项目。本研究使用两个加拿大成人样本开发了匹配的较短形式。方法：将父样本随机分为发育子集和保留子集。项目选择考虑了领域覆盖、冗余、心理测量表现和父形式对应。固定配置在保留子集中进行评估，并在独立样本中进行外部确认。分析检查了因素结构、内部一致性、并发关联、性别不变性以及与痛苦和克服的关联。结果：CQS-20 和 CQO-20 保留了三个匹配的领域：富有同情心地思考/感受、富有同情心地与他人联系和富有同情心地行事。保留分析表明这两种形式都可以接受。在独立样本中，CQO-20 保持了可接受的贴合度，而 CQS-20 显示出较弱的 CFI 和 TLI 值，但保留了其负载模式。内部一致性很强，并发关联遵循方向模式。 CQS-20 支持度量不变性，但不支持标量不变性； CQO-20 支持标量，但不支持严格不变性。条件推理树认为，“痛苦”在自我慈悲方面更为突出，“克服”在对他人的同情方面更为突出。结论：简短的形式将电池从 72 项减少到 40 项，同时保留并行的多维评估。独立评估仍然是必要的。

full_list.title_en: Experimental Study of Cookpot Characteristics and Their Effect on Heat Retention and Energy Storage Potential
full_list.title_zh: 炊具特性及其对保温和储能潜力影响的实验研究
full_list.abstract: Cooking is a daily energy-intensive activity, with substantial inefficiencies linked to heat losses in cookware. This study evaluates the thermal performance of aluminium, stainless steel, cast iron, and clay pots of different sizes to identify their suitability for integration with thermal energy storage (TES). Standardized water-heating tests were used to quantify cooking power, efficiency, and energy distribution between the food, pot body, and surrounding air. Aluminium pots consistently achieved rapid heating (291–887 kJ) with minimal pot-body absorption (17–23 kJ) and moderate air losses (31–54 kJ), making them ideal for lined-TES configurations where rapid heat transfer is essential. Clay and cast iron absorbed substantially more heat (up to 141 kJ), indicating stronger potential for pot-as-storage applications. Larger pots retained heat longer due to favourable surface-area-to-volume ratios. These results provide a material–TES integration framework, highlighting aluminium and stainless steel for efficient lined-TES and clay or cast iron for direct storage-based cooking.
full_list.abstract_zh: 烹饪是一项日常能源密集型活动，炊具的热量损失导致效率严重低下。本研究评估了不同尺寸的铝、不锈钢、铸铁和陶罐的热性能，以确定它们是否适合与热能储存（TES）集成。使用标准化水加热测试来量化烹饪功率、效率以及食物、锅体和周围空气之间的能量分布。铝锅始终能够实现快速加热 (291–887 kJ)，同时锅体吸收极小 (17–23 kJ) 和适度的空气损失 (31–54 kJ)，使其成为需要快速传热的内衬 TES 配置的理想选择。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 烹饪是一项日常能源密集型活动，炊具的热量损失导致效率严重低下。本研究评估了不同尺寸的铝、不锈钢、铸铁和陶罐的热性能，以确定它们是否适合与热能储存（TES）集成。使用标准化水加热测试来量化烹饪功率、效率以及食物、锅体和周围空气之间的能量分布。铝锅始终能够实现快速加热 (291–887 kJ)，同时锅体吸收极小 (17–23 kJ) 和适度的空气损失 (31–54 kJ)，使其成为需要快速传热的内衬 TES 配置的理想选择。粘土和铸铁吸收了更多的热量（高达 141 kJ），表明罐式储存应用的潜力更大。由于有利的表面积与体积比，较大的锅可以更长时间地保留热量。这些结果提供了一个材料-TES 集成框架，重点介绍了用于高效内衬 TES 的铝和不锈钢以及用于直接存储烹饪的粘土或铸铁。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：声子、有限温度和输运性质、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《炊具特性及其对保温和储能潜力影响的实验研究》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Exploring the relationship between Tripela Sports Test performance and eye- hand coordination from KTK3+ in children aged 6–10 years
full_list.title_zh: 探索 6-10 岁儿童 Tripela 运动测试表现与 KTK3+ 眼手协调能力之间的关系
full_list.abstract: Purpose Reliable, low-cost instruments are needed to assess motor competence in children, yet established batteries correlate only weakly to moderately with each other and often require expensive equipment. This study examined the association between the Tripela Sports Test (TST), a simple wall-based kicking-and-catching task using only a ball, and eye-hand coordination (EHC) assessed with the KTK3 + battery, overall and by sex, and compared performance between sexes on both tests.Methods A total of 137 children (69 boys, 68 girls) aged 6 to 10 years (M = 8.23, SD = 1.22) completed the TST and the EHC test. As both measures violated normality, sex differences were analysed with Mann–Whitney U tests and associations with Spearman’s rank-order correlations, for the total sample and separately by sex.Results Boys outperformed girls on the TST (Z = − 5.57, p < .001, r = .48) and the EHC (Z = − 4.34, p < .001, r = .37). Spearman correlations between the TST and the EHC were large and significant across groups (total ρ = .718; boys ρ = .729; girls ρ = .516; all p < .001).Conclusion These findings support the concurrent validity of the TST as a feasible, inexpensive measure of gross motor manipulative coordination in children.
full_list.abstract_zh: 目的需要可靠、低成本的仪器来评估儿童的运动能力，但现有的电池彼此之间的相关性仅为弱到中等，并且通常需要昂贵的设备。本研究考察了 Tripela 运动测试 (TST)（一种仅使用球的简单的基于墙壁的踢接任务）与使用 KTK3 + 电池评估的眼手协调性 (EHC) 之间的总体和性别之间的关联，并比较了两性在两项测试中的表现。方法 共有 137 名 6 至 10 岁儿童（69 名男孩，68 名女孩）（M = 8.23， SD = 1.22）完成了TST和EHC测试。
